verdict.rationale: Morph's APIs are path-versioned (/v1, /api/v1) with dated model snapshots. Its docs give an endpoint-level deprecation notice for the legacy router endpoints, with a backward-compatibility commitment and a migration target. That is a single feature-specific notice, not a general deprecation policy. Missing for 10: a standalone versioning/deprecation policy document, an API changelog, defined sunset timelines or notice periods, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Paths are versioned (/v1, /api/v1) and models carry dated snapshots
The provider endpoints will be removed in a future release
